fields.label: By location
fields.note: Client-side 'By location' dropdown fed from the company feed's location field; no request parameter.

fields.label: Department
fields.note: Published as department on every PUBLIC row of the company feed; there is no dedicated department dropdown on the page.

fields.label: By type
fields.note: Client-side 'By type' dropdown fed from the feed's type field.

notes: phonepe.com/careers/ sends visitors to /careers/job-openings/, whose bundle fetches one static company feed (https://www.phonepe.com/apollo/job-postings/latest.json) and keeps rows where status == 'PUBLIC' and applyUrl is set (152 of 955 rows today). The page's controls (a free-text search box, 'By location', 'By type') are applied in the browser over that feed, and the feed itself takes no parameters, so there is no native filtered request; the scraper downloads the whole feed and filters locally. SmartRecruiters (jobs.smartrecruiters.com/PHONEPELIMITED/<id>) is only the per-posting detail/apply host, and its API is not used as a membership or filter source.
evidence: https://www.phonepe.com/careers/job-openings/ (job-filter-container: search box, By location, By type; populated client-side)
https://www.phonepe.com/apollo/job-postings/latest.json (955 results, 152 PUBLIC rows with applyUrl; type and department fields)
